reviews.title: Not a review, just a user experience
reviews.text: What I was hoping to find was something that could replace my remotes, and this sorta did. While it was able to connect to my tv and also my fire stick remotes, I couldn’t control my TV volume simultaneously while using the fire stick remote, even tho it has a volume up and down. Instead I would have to switch back to my tv to control that. Plus, while I was gaming, I wanted to raise the volume, but the remote was on for the fire stick, when I switched over to tv to control the volume, the video switched on the tv as well and had to hit the PlayStation button to bring the video back to gaming. For those reasons this remote app is not for me.

reviews.title: Don’t believe 5-star reviews.
reviews.text:
The app is misleading out of the gate—they coax you into writing a review for the app disguised as a required part of the initial set-up and they set the default rating to 5 stars.  Only then do they reveal that the app actually isn’t free, and is based on a subscription model, for which they are asking way too much for what this app actually is. 

Sad part is this could be a decent app with better transparency up front, and more reasonable pricing model.  

And yeah there’s a ‘free’ version with very limited functionality, but it is presented as if required to pay.  In short, the app is acting on bad-faith.
